profile.description: Four resident BF16 batches through three BF16-operand/FP32-accumulator projections, FP32 SiLU/product/residual, BF16 stage/output storage; complete stage and canonical/boundary state checks.

timing_protocol.scope: whole four-batch chain including all FP32 accumulations, BF16 conversions, arithmetic, movement, nonlinear/residual and every intermediate/output/state store

memory.scope: bin/*.elf program objects; not union of all ELF loads or physical area

research.hypothesis: Extend the vector/scratch dispatcher with a degree-4 FP32 Taylor exp tail for 4<abs(g)<=8, four repeated squares and stable SiLU division. Keep degree-six central SiLU and native exp outside abs(g)>8. An exhaustive separate BF16 gate screen passed with one quarter of the unchanged local allowance reserved; require full device/fresh validation. This targets costly positive-tail exp fallbacks without weakening precision or allocating new scratch. Set the aligned W1-to-FP32 scratch alias at runtime: this SDK rejects comptime pointer casts. Preserve the same lifetime/capacity predicate and all requested work.
research.falsification: Reject skipped/reordered projection terms, BF16 accumulation, missing stage quantization, stale logical reads, numerical/state/shutdown failures, protected-control changes, speedup below 1.05x or memory above 1.10x. Require six families, fresh matched seed and complete suite guards for cross-shape claims. Reject any alias used while communication is live or any scratch extent exceeding W1; compare complete working-state histories at both seeds.
research.author: unknown

execution_platform.qualification_scope: Requires new matched baselines; old QEMU timings are a distinct evaluator track.
